caption:
349,499 people rated this scale. Almost none of them are wrong.

A bathroom scale is a boring purchase until it's wrong, and this one has been rated by 349,499 separate households. That's not a marketing number — it's a sample size most products never get close to. At 4.7 stars across that many reviews, the errors would show up if they were common.

The Etekcity Digital Body Weight Bathroom Scale gives a digital weight readout at step-on, no dials or guessing where the needle landed. A 4.7-star average held across 349,499 reviews is a statistical signal, not a lucky batch — that volume smooths out fluke units and fake reviews alike.

For $16.87, you get a scale with more reviews behind it than most home products will ever collect, and a rating that's stayed high through all of them.
